name: Vinsys IT Services India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Vinsys IT Services India offers services in IT skill development, training, and certification domain.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments[1][2]
a) Corporate Training & Certification – Flagship vertical offering professional upskilling across 17 domains and 326+ courses.
b) Digital Learning – Includes virtual reality training (VR2), LMS solutions, and digital content creation tools.
c) Software Development – Offers SaaS, cybersecurity, quality engineering, managed IT services, and in-house proprietary platforms like VinLMS, VinProctomate, VinBPM, VinCRM, and VinHRMS.
d) Manpower & Staffing – Provides end-to-end solutions including talent acquisition, payroll, and logistics.
e) Foreign Language Services – Covers training, interpretation, transcription, and localization across 150+ global languages, delivering 250+ projects annually.
f) Business Academy – Focuses on professional development and strategic skill-building programs.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 104 to 129 days.
Working capital days have increased from 80.6 days to 114 days
